security.title: Sign-in and security
security.hint: How you sign in to the CRM and the cabinet: they share the account and the password.

password.title: Password
password.notSet: No password — you sign in with Google or Telegram.
password.description: After saving, your other devices will have to sign in again.
password.rule: At least 8 characters: a lowercase and an uppercase letter, a digit.

google.title: Google
google.notLinked: Not linked. Sign in with one click.
google.onlyWay: This is your only way to sign in — set a password or link Telegram first.
google.unlinkDescription: You will no longer be able to sign in with Google.

result.google_taken: This Google account is linked to another account
result.google_other_linked: Another Google account is linked — unlink it first
result.google_unverified: Google did not confirm the email of this account
result.google_off: Google sign-in is not available right now

telegram.title: Telegram
telegram.notLinked: Not linked. Sign in with one click.
telegram.onlyWay: This is your only way to sign in — set a password first.
telegram.unlinkDescription: You will no longer be able to sign in with Telegram.

signOut.title: Sign out everywhere
signOut.description: If your phone is lost or you signed in on someone else's computer. Signs out of the CRM too.
signOut.confirmDescription: Sessions close everywhere, this device and the CRM included. You can sign in again.

devices.title: Devices
devices.hint: Where the account is signed in now.
devices.endedOthers: {count, plural, =0 {There were no other devices} one {# device signed out} other {# devices signed out}}
